question: Directive Principles of State Policy of the Indian constitution are borrowed from the constitution of which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ireland.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Directive Principles of State Policy** of the Indian constitution are borrowed from the constitution of** Ireland.**
 
• Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP) in the Indian Constitution are mentioned in** Part IV, Articles 36 to 51. **
 
• T
